name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the backup policy. Valid values:

DataBackupPolicy: data backup
LogBackupPolicy: log backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：

DataBackupPolicy：数据备份
LogBackupPolicy：日志备份
parameters.name: backup_policy_mode

parameters.help_en: The time at which to perform a backup task. Format: HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC). This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy. This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh: 执行备份任务的时间。格式：HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。 仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. Specify at least two days. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday

This parameter works together with the BackupInterval parameter to determine the backup policy. For example, if this parameter specifies Saturday and Sunday and BackupInterval specifies 30 minutes, a backup is performed every 30 minutes on Saturday and Sunday.
This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期。至少需要指定2天，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开。取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

与BackupInterval参数共同决定备份策略。例如：本参数指定周六周日备份，BackupInterval参数指定30分钟，则在每周的周六和周日每隔30分钟执行一次备份。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which data backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730.

This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
数据备份保留天数，取值：7~730。

BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup. Valid values:

Enable: enabled.
Disabled: disabled.

For SQL Server instances, log backup is enabled by default and cannot be disabled. However, you can modify the log backup frequency as follows:

Log backup frequency of every 5 minutes: Set BackupLog to Enable and leave LogBackupFrequency empty. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html. This configuration is not supported when backup on the secondary instance is preferred (BackupPriority is set to 1). Otherwise, an error is returned.
Log backup frequency of every 30 minutes: Leave BackupLog empty and set LogBackupFrequency to LogInterval.
Log backup frequency consistent with data backup: Leave both BackupLog and LogBackupFrequency empty.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy and is used to enable or disable log backup
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志备份。取值：

Enable：开启。
Disabled：关闭。

对于SQL Server实例，日志备份默认开启，无法关闭，但您可以修改日志备份频率，具体如下：

日志备份频率为每5分钟一次：BackupLog设置为Enable，LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html。**该配置不支持在设置了优先备库（BackupPriority为1）时使用，否则将会报错。**
日志备份频率为每30分钟一次：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency设置为LogInterval。
日志备份频率为与数据备份一致：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
parameters.name: backup_log

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which log backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730. The value cannot be greater than the number of days for which data backups are retained.

When log backup is enabled, you can set the retention period of log backup files. This setting is supported only for MySQL and PostgreSQL instances.
This parameter applies when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy or LogBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
日志备份保留天数。取值：7~730，且不大于数据备份保留天数。

当开启日志备份时，可设置日志备份文件的保留天数，目前仅支持MySQL和PostgreSQL实例设置该值。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy或LogBackupPolicy时都适用
parameters.name: log_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable instance log backup for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB instances. Valid values:
True or 1: enabled.
False or 0: shutdown.

Instance log backup for SQL Server instances is enabled by default and cannot be shut down. You do not need to configure this parameter for SQL Server instances.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is used to enable or shutdown log backup
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB实例是否开启日志备份。取值：
True或1：开启。
False或0：关闭。

SQL Server实例日志备份默认开启，无法关闭。因此SQL Server实例无需关注此参数。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable point-in-time recovery for MySQL instances. Valid values:
True: enabled.
False: disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy and BackupLog is set to Enable. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例是否开启任意时间点恢复。取值：
True：开启
False：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy且BackupLog为Enable时生效。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
parameters.name: enable_pitr_protection

parameters.help_en:
The number of hours for which instance log backups are retained on the MySQL instance. Valid values: 0 to 168 (7 × 24). A value of 0 indicates that instance log backups are not retained.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is required in this case
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例日志备份本地保留小时数。取值：0~7*24，0表示不保留。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: local_log_retention_hours

parameters.help_en:
The maximum usage of the local log storage space for a MySQL instance. If the usage exceeds this value, the system starts to clean up binary logs from the earliest one until the usage drops below this threshold. Valid values: 0 to 50. The default value is not modified.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is required in this case
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例本地日志最大循环空间使用率，超出后，则从最早的Binlog开始清理，直到空间使用率低于该比例。取值：0~50。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: local_log_retention_space

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to unconditionally clean up binary logs when the disk usage of a MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining disk space is less than 5 GB. Valid values: Enable | Disable. The default value is not modified.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is required in this case
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例使用空间大于80%，或者剩余空间小于5 GB时，是否无条件清理Binlog。取值：Enable | Disable。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: high_space_usage_protection

parameters.help_en:
The log backup frequency for SQL Server instances. Valid values:
LogInterval: every 30 minutes.
Empty (no value required): every 5 minutes or consistent with data backup.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例的日志备份频率，取值：
LogInterval：每30分钟。
空（无需传值）：每5分钟备份一次或与数据备份一致。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: log_backup_frequency

parameters.help_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: not compressed.
1: zlib compression in tar.gz format.
2: parallel zlib compression.
4: quicklz compression in xb.gz format. This method is applicable only to MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 and can be used for https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html.
8: quicklz compression in xb.gz format. This method is applicable only to MySQL 8.0. Individual database and table restoration is not supported.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
备份压缩方式。取值：
0：不压缩。
1：zlib压缩，格式为tar.gz。
2：并行zlib压缩。
4：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 5.6/5.7，此备份压缩方式可用于https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html。
8：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 8.0。暂不支持单库单表恢复。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: compress_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which archived backups are retained. The default value is 0, which indicates that archived backup is not enabled. Valid values: 30 to 1095.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留天数。默认为0，表示未开启归档备份。取值：30~1095。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
The retention cycle for archived backups. The number of backups that can be retained within this cycle is determined by ArchiveBackupKeepCount. The default value is 0. Valid values:
ByMonth: monthly
ByWeek: weekly
KeepAll: all retained

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留周期，该周期内能保存的备份个数由ArchiveBackupKeepCount决定。默认为0。取值：
ByMonth：月
ByWeek：周
KeepAll：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_keep_policy

parameters.help_en:
The number of archived backups to retain. The default value is 1. Valid values:
When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByMonth, valid values are 1 to 31.
When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByWeek, valid values are 1 to 7.

When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to KeepAll, this parameter does not need to be specified.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留个数。默认为1。取值：
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByMonth时，取值为1~31。
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByWeek时，取值为1~7。

当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为KeepAll时，本参数无需传入。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_keep_count

parameters.help_en:
The data retention policy for archived backups of deleted MySQL instances. Valid values:
None: not retained.
Lastest: the last backup is retained.
All: all backups are retained.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL cloud disk instances purchased on or after February 1, 2024, the default value of ReleasedKeepPolicy is Lastest. For instance with Premium Local SSDs, the default value is None. For details about this feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2836955.html
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL已删除实例的归档备份保留策略。取值：
None：不保留
Lastest：保留最后一个
All：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效。
2024年02月01日及之后新购的RDS MySQL云盘实例ReleasedKeepPolicy默认值为Lastest；高性能本地盘实例默认值为None。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2836955.html
parameters.name: released_keep_policy

parameters.help_en:
The number of binary logs to retain on the instance. The default value is 60. Valid values: 6 to 100.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy.
For MySQL instances, you can set this parameter to -1, which indicates that no limit is imposed on the number of binary logs retained on the instance
parameters.help_zh:
本地Binlog保留个数。默认为60。取值：6~100。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为LogBackupPolicy时生效。
如果实例类型为MySQL，可以传入-1，即不限制本地Binlog的保留个数
parameters.name: log_backup_local_retention_number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable backup within seconds. Valid values:
Flash: enabled.
Standard: disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启秒级备份。取值：
Flash：开启
Standard：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot backup frequency. Valid values:
15: every 15 minutes.
30: every 30 minutes.
60: every 60 minutes.
120: every 120 minutes.
180: every 180 minutes.
240: every 240 minutes.
360: every 360 minutes.
480: every 480 minutes.
720: every 720 minutes.

This parameter works together with the PreferredBackupPeriod parameter to determine the backup policy.
MySQL instances must be cloud disk instances that run MySQL 5.7 or 8.0 and belong to the high-availability series or Cluster Edition.
PostgreSQL instances must be cloud disk instances.
SQL Server instances must have https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html enabled.
This parameter is invalid when Category is set to Flash.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
快照备份频率。取值：
15：15分钟。
30：30分钟。
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
180：180分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
480：480分钟。
720：720分钟。

与PreferredBackupPeriod参数共同决定备份策略。
MySQL实例必须是云盘5.7、8.0 高可用系列、集群系列实例。
PostgreSQL实例必须是云盘实例。
SQL Server实例必须已开启https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html。
Category参数为Flash时本参数无效。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_interval

parameters.help_en:
The backup method for SQL Server instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
Physical (default): physical backup.
Snapshot: snapshot backup.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版实例的备份方式。取值：
Physical（默认值）：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable incremental backup for SQL Server instances with cloud disks or MySQL instances with local SSDs. Valid values:
False (default): disabled.
True: enabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版、MySQL本地盘实例是否开启增量备份。取值：
False（默认）：关闭
True：开启

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: enable_increment_data_backup

parameters.help_en:
The high-frequency incremental backup frequency for MySQL instances with local SSDs. Valid values:
60: every 60 minutes.
120: every 120 minutes.
240: every 240 minutes.
360: every 360 minutes.
720: every 720 minutes.

This parameter takes effect only when EnableIncrementDataBackup is set to True
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL本地盘实例高频增量备份频率。取值：
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
720：720分钟。

该参数仅在EnableIncrementDataBackup参数为True时生效
parameters.name: inc_backup_interval

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html setting for SQL Server Cluster Edition instances. Valid values:
1: secondary instance preferred.
2: primary instance forced.
 
This parameter takes effect only when BackupMethod is set to Physical. If BackupMethod is set to Snapshot, SQL Server Cluster Edition instances are forced to perform backups on the primary instance.
After secondary instance preferred (BackupPriority set to 1) is configured, the 5-minute log backup policy (BackupLog set to Enable and LogBackupFrequency left empty) is not supported. Otherwise, an error is returned. Set the log backup frequency to every 30 minutes or consistent with data backup
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server集群版实例https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html的设置选项。取值：
1：优先备库
2：强制主库
 
仅当BackupMethod取值为Physical时，该参数才生效。如果BackupMethod设置为Snapshot，SQL Server集群版实例将强制在主库备份。
设置优先备库（BackupPriority为1）后，不支持开启5分钟日志备份策略（BackupLog为Enable且LogBackupFrequency为空），否则将会报错。请将日志备份频率设置为每30分钟一次或与数据备份一致
parameters.name: backup_priority

parameters.help_en: The EnableAdvancedBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh: The EnableAdvancedBackupPolicy
parameters.name: enable_advanced_backup_policy

parameters.help_en: The AdvancedDataPolicies
parameters.help_zh: The AdvancedDataPolicies
parameters.name: advanced_data_policies

parameters.help_en: The AdvancedLogPolicies
parameters.help_zh: The AdvancedLogPolicies
parameters.name: advanced_log_policies

v1_parameters.help_en:
The number of archived backups to retain. The default value is 1. Valid values:
When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByMonth, valid values are 1 to 31.
When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByWeek, valid values are 1 to 7.

When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to KeepAll, this parameter does not need to be specified.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留个数。默认为1。取值：
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByMonth时，取值为1~31。
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByWeek时，取值为1~7。

当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为KeepAll时，本参数无需传入。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: ArchiveBackupKeepCount

v1_parameters.help_en:
The retention cycle for archived backups. The number of backups that can be retained within this cycle is determined by ArchiveBackupKeepCount. The default value is 0. Valid values:
ByMonth: monthly
ByWeek: weekly
KeepAll: all retained

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留周期，该周期内能保存的备份个数由ArchiveBackupKeepCount决定。默认为0。取值：
ByMonth：月
ByWeek：周
KeepAll：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy

v1_parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which archived backups are retained. The default value is 0, which indicates that archived backup is not enabled. Valid values: 30 to 1095.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留天数。默认为0，表示未开启归档备份。取值：30~1095。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: ArchiveBackupRetentionPeriod

v1_parameters.help_en:
The snapshot backup frequency. Valid values:
15: every 15 minutes.
30: every 30 minutes.
60: every 60 minutes.
120: every 120 minutes.
180: every 180 minutes.
240: every 240 minutes.
360: every 360 minutes.
480: every 480 minutes.
720: every 720 minutes.

This parameter works together with the PreferredBackupPeriod parameter to determine the backup policy.
MySQL instances must be cloud disk instances that run MySQL 5.7 or 8.0 and belong to the high-availability series or Cluster Edition.
PostgreSQL instances must be cloud disk instances.
SQL Server instances must have https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html enabled.
This parameter is invalid when Category is set to Flash.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
快照备份频率。取值：
15：15分钟。
30：30分钟。
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
180：180分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
480：480分钟。
720：720分钟。

与PreferredBackupPeriod参数共同决定备份策略。
MySQL实例必须是云盘5.7、8.0 高可用系列、集群系列实例。
PostgreSQL实例必须是云盘实例。
SQL Server实例必须已开启https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html。
Category参数为Flash时本参数无效。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: BackupInterval

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup. Valid values:

Enable: enabled.
Disabled: disabled.

For SQL Server instances, log backup is enabled by default and cannot be disabled. However, you can modify the log backup frequency as follows:

Log backup frequency of every 5 minutes: Set BackupLog to Enable and leave LogBackupFrequency empty. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html. This configuration is not supported when backup on the secondary instance is preferred (BackupPriority is set to 1). Otherwise, an error is returned.
Log backup frequency of every 30 minutes: Leave BackupLog empty and set LogBackupFrequency to LogInterval.
Log backup frequency consistent with data backup: Leave both BackupLog and LogBackupFrequency empty.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy and is used to enable or disable log backup
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志备份。取值：

Enable：开启。
Disabled：关闭。

对于SQL Server实例，日志备份默认开启，无法关闭，但您可以修改日志备份频率，具体如下：

日志备份频率为每5分钟一次：BackupLog设置为Enable，LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html。**该配置不支持在设置了优先备库（BackupPriority为1）时使用，否则将会报错。**
日志备份频率为每30分钟一次：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency设置为LogInterval。
日志备份频率为与数据备份一致：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
v1_parameters.name: BackupLog

v1_parameters.help_en:
The backup method for SQL Server instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
Physical (default): physical backup.
Snapshot: snapshot backup.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版实例的备份方式。取值：
Physical（默认值）：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: BackupMethod

v1_parameters.help_en:
The type of the backup policy. Valid values:

DataBackupPolicy: data backup
LogBackupPolicy: log backup
v1_parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：

DataBackupPolicy：数据备份
LogBackupPolicy：日志备份
v1_parameters.name: BackupPolicyMode

v1_parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html setting for SQL Server Cluster Edition instances. Valid values:
1: secondary instance preferred.
2: primary instance forced.
 
This parameter takes effect only when BackupMethod is set to Physical. If BackupMethod is set to Snapshot, SQL Server Cluster Edition instances are forced to perform backups on the primary instance.
After secondary instance preferred (BackupPriority set to 1) is configured, the 5-minute log backup policy (BackupLog set to Enable and LogBackupFrequency left empty) is not supported. Otherwise, an error is returned. Set the log backup frequency to every 30 minutes or consistent with data backup
v1_parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server集群版实例https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html的设置选项。取值：
1：优先备库
2：强制主库
 
仅当BackupMethod取值为Physical时，该参数才生效。如果BackupMethod设置为Snapshot，SQL Server集群版实例将强制在主库备份。
设置优先备库（BackupPriority为1）后，不支持开启5分钟日志备份策略（BackupLog为Enable且LogBackupFrequency为空），否则将会报错。请将日志备份频率设置为每30分钟一次或与数据备份一致
v1_parameters.name: BackupPriority

v1_parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which data backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730.

This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据备份保留天数，取值：7~730。

BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: BackupRetentionPeriod

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable backup within seconds. Valid values:
Flash: enabled.
Standard: disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否开启秒级备份。取值：
Flash：开启
Standard：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: Category

v1_parameters.help_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: not compressed.
1: zlib compression in tar.gz format.
2: parallel zlib compression.
4: quicklz compression in xb.gz format. This method is applicable only to MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 and can be used for https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html.
8: quicklz compression in xb.gz format. This method is applicable only to MySQL 8.0. Individual database and table restoration is not supported.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
备份压缩方式。取值：
0：不压缩。
1：zlib压缩，格式为tar.gz。
2：并行zlib压缩。
4：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 5.6/5.7，此备份压缩方式可用于https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html。
8：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 8.0。暂不支持单库单表恢复。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: CompressType

v1_parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取
v1_parameters.name: DBInstanceId

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable instance log backup for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB instances. Valid values:
True or 1: enabled.
False or 0: shutdown.

Instance log backup for SQL Server instances is enabled by default and cannot be shut down. You do not need to configure this parameter for SQL Server instances.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is used to enable or shutdown log backup
v1_parameters.help_zh:
MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB实例是否开启日志备份。取值：
True或1：开启。
False或0：关闭。

SQL Server实例日志备份默认开启，无法关闭。因此SQL Server实例无需关注此参数。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
v1_parameters.name: EnableBackupLog

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable incremental backup for SQL Server instances with cloud disks or MySQL instances with local SSDs. Valid values:
False (default): disabled.
True: enabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版、MySQL本地盘实例是否开启增量备份。取值：
False（默认）：关闭
True：开启

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: EnableIncrementDataBackup

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable point-in-time recovery for MySQL instances. Valid values:
True: enabled.
False: disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy and BackupLog is set to Enable. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
v1_parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例是否开启任意时间点恢复。取值：
True：开启
False：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy且BackupLog为Enable时生效。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
v1_parameters.name: EnablePitrProtection

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to unconditionally clean up binary logs when the disk usage of a MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining disk space is less than 5 GB. Valid values: Enable | Disable. The default value is not modified.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is required in this case
v1_parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例使用空间大于80%，或者剩余空间小于5 GB时，是否无条件清理Binlog。取值：Enable | Disable。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
v1_parameters.name: HighSpaceUsageProtection

v1_parameters.help_en:
The high-frequency incremental backup frequency for MySQL instances with local SSDs. Valid values:
60: every 60 minutes.
120: every 120 minutes.
240: every 240 minutes.
360: every 360 minutes.
720: every 720 minutes.

This parameter takes effect only when EnableIncrementDataBackup is set to True
v1_parameters.help_zh:
MySQL本地盘实例高频增量备份频率。取值：
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
720：720分钟。

该参数仅在EnableIncrementDataBackup参数为True时生效
v1_parameters.name: IncBackupInterval

v1_parameters.help_en:
The number of hours for which instance log backups are retained on the MySQL instance. Valid values: 0 to 168 (7 × 24). A value of 0 indicates that instance log backups are not retained.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is required in this case
v1_parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例日志备份本地保留小时数。取值：0~7*24，0表示不保留。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
v1_parameters.name: LocalLogRetentionHours

v1_parameters.help_en:
The maximum usage of the local log storage space for a MySQL instance. If the usage exceeds this value, the system starts to clean up binary logs from the earliest one until the usage drops below this threshold. Valid values: 0 to 50. The default value is not modified.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy and is required in this case
v1_parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例本地日志最大循环空间使用率，超出后，则从最早的Binlog开始清理，直到空间使用率低于该比例。取值：0~50。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
v1_parameters.name: LocalLogRetentionSpace

v1_parameters.help_en:
The log backup frequency for SQL Server instances. Valid values:
LogInterval: every 30 minutes.
Empty (no value required): every 5 minutes or consistent with data backup.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例的日志备份频率，取值：
LogInterval：每30分钟。
空（无需传值）：每5分钟备份一次或与数据备份一致。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: LogBackupFrequency

v1_parameters.help_en:
The number of binary logs to retain on the instance. The default value is 60. Valid values: 6 to 100.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy.
For MySQL instances, you can set this parameter to -1, which indicates that no limit is imposed on the number of binary logs retained on the instance
v1_parameters.help_zh:
本地Binlog保留个数。默认为60。取值：6~100。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为LogBackupPolicy时生效。
如果实例类型为MySQL，可以传入-1，即不限制本地Binlog的保留个数
v1_parameters.name: LogBackupLocalRetentionNumber

v1_parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which log backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730. The value cannot be greater than the number of days for which data backups are retained.

When log backup is enabled, you can set the retention period of log backup files. This setting is supported only for MySQL and PostgreSQL instances.
This parameter applies when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy or LogBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
日志备份保留天数。取值：7~730，且不大于数据备份保留天数。

当开启日志备份时，可设置日志备份文件的保留天数，目前仅支持MySQL和PostgreSQL实例设置该值。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy或LogBackupPolicy时都适用
v1_parameters.name: LogBackupRetentionPeriod

v1_parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. Specify at least two days. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday

This parameter works together with the BackupInterval parameter to determine the backup policy. For example, if this parameter specifies Saturday and Sunday and BackupInterval specifies 30 minutes, a backup is performed every 30 minutes on Saturday and Sunday.
This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh:
备份周期。至少需要指定2天，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开。取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

与BackupInterval参数共同决定备份策略。例如：本参数指定周六周日备份，BackupInterval参数指定30分钟，则在每周的周六和周日每隔30分钟执行一次备份。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: PreferredBackupPeriod

v1_parameters.help_en: The time at which to perform a backup task. Format: HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC). This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy. This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
v1_parameters.help_zh: 执行备份任务的时间。格式：HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。 仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
v1_parameters.name: PreferredBackupTime

v1_parameters.help_en:
The data retention policy for archived backups of deleted MySQL instances. Valid values:
None: not retained.
Lastest: the last backup is retained.
All: all backups are retained.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL cloud disk instances purchased on or after February 1, 2024, the default value of ReleasedKeepPolicy is Lastest. For instance with Premium Local SSDs, the default value is None. For details about this feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2836955.html
v1_parameters.help_zh:
MySQL已删除实例的归档备份保留策略。取值：
None：不保留
Lastest：保留最后一个
All：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效。
2024年02月01日及之后新购的RDS MySQL云盘实例ReleasedKeepPolicy默认值为Lastest；高性能本地盘实例默认值为None。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2836955.html
v1_parameters.name: ReleasedKeepPolicy
